title: What the numbers mean in real life
note: Rules of thumb for a quick picture, worked out from the specifications above. Real results depend on how you use the device and its settings.
storage: {gb}: ≈ {photos} photos (12 MP, about 3 MB each) or ≈ {hours} hours of 4K video (30 fps, about 170 MB a minute). The system takes roughly 15 %.
storageGames: {gb}: room for about {n} big games of 80 GB each, after the system's share.
camera: {mp}: sharp prints up to about {w} × {h} cm (300 dpi) — a poster twice that size still looks good from a step away.
zoom: {x} optical zoom: something 30 m away looks as close as if it were {d} m away, without losing sharpness.
brightSun2: {nits}: very easy to read even in bright midday sun.
brightMid: {nits}: fine indoors and in the shade; can be hard to read in strong sun.
brightLow: {nits}: best indoors; outdoors in sunlight the screen looks dim.
refresh: {hz}: a new picture every {ms} ms (at 60 Hz: every 16.7 ms), so motion and scrolling look smoother.
noise: {db}: {like}. Every 10 dB more sounds about twice as loud.
noiseLike: about as quiet as a whisper
like a quiet office or light rain
battAudio: {h}: about {days} days of listening at 2 hours a day.
battLaptop: {h}: about {days} working days of 8 hours on one charge in the manufacturer's test; real use is usually shorter.
flightOk: {wh}: allowed in hand luggage on most airlines without approval (the usual limit is 100 Wh).
flightAsk: {wh}: above 100 Wh, so most airlines need to approve it for hand luggage (upper limit 160 Wh).
wash: {kg}: suits a household of {people}; about {shirts} T-shirts (≈ 200 g each) in one load.
water: {l} per cycle: about {b} buckets of 10 litres.
fridge: {l}: suits a household of {people} (rule of thumb: about 150 L for one person plus 50–70 L for each extra person).
lamp: {h}: about {y} years of viewing at 3 hours a day.
beans: {g} of beans: about {n} single espressos (≈ 7 g each) before you refill.
tank: {l} water tank: up to about {n} espressos (40 ml each); some water also goes on rinsing.
pressure: {bar}: this is the pump's maximum. Espresso is brewed at about 9 bar, so a bigger number doesn't mean better coffee.
tvDist: {in}: comfortable 4K viewing distance about {a}–{b} m from the screen.
weight: {kg}: about as heavy as {n} one-litre bottles of water.
